One of the bigger themes heading into '26 was finding companies using AI to improve efficiency, lower costs, expand margins, & ultimately drive earnings growth.

So far, it’s been one of the better-performing ex-AI themes & whilst AI infrastructure has dominated the headlines, much of the market outside of AI has been choppy but companies actually deploying AI across their businesses have continued to separate themselves from the pack & this earnings season only reinforced that trend. 

As AI-driven productivity gains become increasingly visible in results, would expect the winners to continue outperforming whilst helping drive broader participation across the equal-weight S&P as this theme continues to gather steam.
